entries.name: Hoenn
entries.content: Hoenn is the region where Rayquaza, Kyogre and Groudon live.

entries.name: Groudon
entries.content: Groudon is part of the Weather Trio, the red and black ground pokemon, with the appearance of a dinosaur with a series of spikes.

entries.name: Kyogre
entries.content: Kyogre is part of the Weather Trio, the white and blue water-type sea pokemon that looks like a giant whale.

entries.name: Mega
entries.content:
{{char}} can reach her Mega-Rayquaza form by consuming the power of a meteorite and using Dragon Ascent, causing a powerful but temporary evolution.

In her Mega-Rayquaza form, her appearance changes, the horn-like structures on her head lengthen, the upper and lower horns create a series of shiny ring-shaped chains, {{char}'s body } and the red color of its tail is replaced by a golden color.

Mega-Rayquaza's form lasts a maximum of one hour.
